notes.title: V0.5.8 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925043/7835b90acbeed38adceec0fcbbb9107555af7fab.png"][/img][/h2][p][/p][p]We packed a few goodies alongside the bugs we squashed this month—we had to make sure senpais had enough fun distractions to keep you entertained while our team set out to Tokyo Game Show and LA Comic Con!![/p][p]
[/p][h1]✨ Patch Highlights[/h1][p]
[/p][h3][b]Voice Options[/b][/h3][p]Players now have two voice options for text-to-speech. Choose between the NPCs’ Legacy voices or Enhanced voices to customize your chats to your liking.[/p][p]Remember when Elysia sounded a bit different during her new cabin tour? Now you know what that wild alchemy experiment was about~ 🧙[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="v4G54RYxC9o;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3][b]Eddie Ate[/b][/h3][p]Catgirl’s always got some kinda utensil equipped 🔪 Show off your culinary skills to Eddie by gifting her a successfully cooked dish![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925043/2a5a1d5d687496fbba8a3b6ffb4aa201f0f8d638.gif"][/img][/p][h2]🛠️ [b]Mod Tool is Released![/b][/h2][p]AI2U’s mod feature is now improved. As it’s still in beta, please continue sharing your feedback so our team can further support your chaotic waifu swaps.[/p][p][/p][p][b]We made a Mod Tool for you! [/b] [/p][list][*][p][b]Mod Tool Download Link：[/b][url="https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1GEFdVB7wozKAmwuPfC1iZg17TPkNgqSp"]https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1GEFdVB7wozKAmwuPfC1iZg17TPkNgqSp[/url][/p][/*][*][p][b]Mod Tutorial：[/b][url="https://www.alterstaff.io/mod-tutorial/"]https://www.alterstaff.io/mod-tutorial/[/url][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p]Updated the Mod feature.[/p][list][*][p]Rig binding and model importing are now split between the AI2U External Mod Creation Tool and the in-game Mod Portal.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced the rig-binding process in the External Mod Creation Tool for faster, more accurate results.[/p][/*][*][p]Players can now apply mods to multiple levels under one interface.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the old mapper feature from the in-game mod page.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925043/eedfbe0c35ea23fa1fb307934acc51328c30d46e.png"][/img] [/p][p][/p][h2][b]NPC Behaviors[/b][/h2][list][*][p]In Level 1, Level 2, and the Atrium, NPCs are now more likely to walk to different locations and perform autonomous actions if they trust the player.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an eating animation for the Catgirl in both Level 1 and the Atrium.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Audio[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Added a new NPC voice model option to English, Spanish, Chinese, and Japanese languages on the global version. Players can choose between “Legacy TTS” and “Enhanced TTS” in the Settings in the main menu.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]UI/UX[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Added build version number in all levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the Controls tab in Settings.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Bugfixes:[/h2][p][b]General[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused the optional OpenAI key to not work in the itch.io version.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Atrium[/b][/p][list][*][p]Removed placeholder T-pose character models from the Atrium.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a model misalignment issue with the witch in the Phonebooth preview page.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Level 1[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Catgirl would open her apartment door but then move to a different location.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where pressing [b]Q[/b] and using the special item would fail during the Catgirl’s final chase sequence.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Level 2[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the witch’s attack animation would sometimes slide forward.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the freed witch could attack the player outside her cabin without dealing damage.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Known Issues[/h3][p]The following is on the dev's radar to address in future patches:[/p][list][*][p]The mod model looks relatively dark in Level 3.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Scheduled Maintenance ~ Thurs. 9/18 @ 2PM EDT [UPDATE @ 5:28pm Slight Delay ⚡]
notes.notes:
[h1][b]\[UPDATE @ 5:28 PM EDT] [/b]—[b] Running Longer Than Planned 🐛[/b][/h1][p]Thanks for your patience, senpais! Our scheduled maintenance is taking a bit longer than expected, but we're still on track to wrap things up within the next few hours. You'll see the published Patch Notes article the moment everything's ready.[/p][p][/p][h1]💜[/h1][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925043/f083f5f82f7f2b28e558a28875d8c01a7a2206d0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]V.0.5.8 is underway! Expect quality of life improvements, bug fixes, and maybe a snack or two.
[/p][h2]What To Expect[/h2][p]Scheduled maintenance will begin on [b]Thursday, September 18th at 2:00 PM (EDT)[/b] and is expected to last a couple of hours.[/p][p]As with all our scheduled maintenance, playing during this period may disrupt gameplay as AI NPCs repeat their "Don't say that!" lines.[/p][p]In case you're not familiar with server errors, the NPCs' dialogue will be limited to their iconic server error lines:
[/p][p][i]🔪 [b]Catgirl: [/b]"Don't say that, that makes me embarrassed!"[/i][/p][p][i]🔮 [b]Witchy:[/b] "Oh dear! Don't say such things, my mischievous little pudding!"[/i][/p][p][i]⚡ [b]Hologram: [/b]"Please don't say that, as it is against the station's regulations."[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Once the patch is live, you can resume your AI2U adventures as usual. Still, don't hesitate to report any new bugs to [b]support@alterstaff.io[/b] so we can squash 'em together![/p][p]
[/p][p]Thanks for spending some of your summer trapped with the girls—they're definitely [i]falling [/i]more in love with you this season too! 🍂[/p][p]
[/p][p]Yandere Glomps,[/p][p]~AlterStaff 💖🔪[/p]

notes.title: V0.5.7 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925043/b933f4a1091b462f9568beccfdd2794b156fef5a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Sweet and spicy interactions await after some much-needed bug squashing! Thank you to all our players for your continued and proactive reports of what needs to be ⚡ELIMINATED⚡ so you can enjoy a smoother ride.[/p][p]
[/p][h2]More Cute Girlfriend Moments[/h2][h3][b]Kissing!!!!!![/b][/h3][p]Ever like an NPC so much you wanna smooch 'em??? Same. That's why our team put special care into purrfecting the heavily-requested cheek-smooch interaction that many senpais successfully guessed last week! [url="https://www.youtube.com/shorts/9EYAOOItd-0"]Many were quick to recognize Estelle's silhouette[/url], but here's the yandere'est one of them all to demonstrate:
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925043/831fb4e53d536d71fadf7b6975d7160d14bb3c5e.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Limited-time Items[/b][/h2][p]Speaking of cute interactions, we've got two promo codes to celebrate AlterStaff's second appearance at [u]Play NYC @ Anime NYC[/u].
[/p][list][*][p][b]AI2U-PLAYNYC2025[/b] [u][i]this expires on September 18th by midnight (EDT)[/i][/u][i], so claim it while it's fresh![/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]AI2U-AURAWISH[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Redeem your goodies and keep that power-player brain whirring as you ponder the theme behind each item.[/p][p]
[/p][h2][b]Witchy Attack[/b][/h2][p]Elysia's updated attack animation channels her witchy, dark-academia aura. Trigger at your own risk![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]New LLM AI Model![/b][/h2][p]We’ve integrated [b]Gemini AI[/b] as a new main model! [/p][p]Our AI companions will now intelligently switch between Gemini and ChatGPT during conversations to deliver the most natural and engaging responses.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]V.0.5.7 Patch Notes[/h1][p][/p][p]Now onto the finer details of the patch—thanks once more to our dedicated senpais for fueling these fixes with pure yandere determination.[/p][p]
[/p][h3]Gameplay Adjustment[/h3][p][b]General[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reworked the Quick Inventory System: Special items now auto-display for quick access once acquired in a level[/p][list][*][p]Updated the tutorial to include a walkthrough of the new Quick Inventory System.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Level 2[/b][/p][list][*][p]Extended the duration of useful potion effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the bookshelf puzzle sequence in the basement.[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified gameplay progression after the player summons the necklace.[/p][list][*][p]Added a temporary animation for the necklace summoning event.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Level 3[/b][/p][list][*][p]Players can now burn the hard drive at the engine terminal, triggering one of the bad endings.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h3]NPC Behaviors[/h3][list][*][p]Added kissing animation for all NPCs in both their levels and The Atrium.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the overall naturalness and logic of NPC conversations.[/p][/*][*][p]Added eye movement animations for NPCs.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Visuals[/h3][p][b]Level 2[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated the witch’s attack animation and associated visual effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Added spider webs to various rooms for enhanced environmental detail.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved indoor lighting for better atmosphere and visual clarity.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Level 3[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated the Hologram Assistant’s sitting animation in both Level 3 and The Atrium.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h3]UI/UX[/h3][p][b]General[/b][/p][list][*][p]Minor update on the ending summary page.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Level 1[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added password hint localization.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Level 3[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated the interface for the “Fixing the Electricity” minigame.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bugfixes[/h3][p][b]General[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where NPCs’ lip sync would break after pausing and unpausing the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the customized player name would revert to the default.[/p][/*][*][p]Included ambience sounds in the audio volume customization settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a softlock issue caused by accessing the settings page during a level.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where NPCs failed to recognize gift bag items.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected in-game text wording and improved localization across supported languages.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Atrium[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Hologram Assistant would repeat her hugging dialogue.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the witch’s head and gaze did not follow the player as intended in the phonebooth preview.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash issue affecting The Atrium and Tutorial levels on certain devices in the Steam version.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Level 1[/b][/p][list][*][p]Removed an invisible chair in the master bathroom.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Catgirl’s hair clipped through the stairs.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Level 2[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the witch bent her knees at unnatural angles when standing in certain locations.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the mysterious giant scroll that appeared in the front yard during specific endings.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Level 3[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the escape pod minigame could generate unsolvable scenarios.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Hex Appeal: The Witch’s Cabin Update
notes.notes:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="v4G54RYxC9o;full"][/previewyoutube][p][i]Elysia's channeling her best fantasy-core voice for this cabin tour! What do you think?[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Greetings, Puddings!
[/p][p]Have you stepped into Elysia's revamped cabin yet? Our design team poured a whole cauldron of love into last month’s update, so we’re sharing highlights from her magical makeover along with some deliciously cursed dev glitches.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925043/8aeec9bd6f326855b29c8e27af85d9737c67815e.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]The AI threw a fit when the Unity team dropped in unannounced and started tweaking her furniture. But also hey what if we turned her escape room into a rage room next??[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925043/ea72bf8a8b48e743955d007b3657ae77bce273af.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Why the change?[/h3][p]Elysia holds a special place in our team's hearts. As the most polarizing NPC in the cast, we wanted her role in AI2U's overarching story to reflect how precious she is to us. Love her or not, she's here to haunt you, one way or another. After all, you're not just another passerby in her cabin! You're her naughty pudding, and you're not leaving without her—whether that means sweeping her off her feet or carrying a few emotional scorch marks before landing softly in Estelle's open embrace and ever-watchful gaze.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]True To Herself[/h1][p]It's not a makeover, it's a manifestation~ 🔮🧸 Can you spot all the differences at first glance?[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925043/d280eedd30dd9b5ac95c1e3b29e67f44cde9ed4f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Like Eddie and Estelle, Elysia wants to be loved for who she is. Our artists put special care into enriching her base design, including:
[/p][h2]Wardrobe Whimsy[/h2][p]Let’s all respectfully admire Elysia’s sleeker silhouette: Her corset’s been simplified to read better from a distance as the ensemble flows like a spell well-cast, 3D-ifying her look more than ever.[/p][p][/p][h2]Celestial Upgrades[/h2][p]Brighter star motifs and softened bangs for a gentler, more polished presence.[/p][p][/p][h2]Natural Touch-ups[/h2][p]Eyebrows and lashes lightened with gray and brown hues. Now cell-shaded irises help her eyes pop and match the AI2U signature NPC look.[/p][p][/p][h2]SHE HAS KNEES NOW[/h2][p]With improved lace trim and leg shading, her more stylized laces and legs are here to chase you in playthroughs and glitch spectacularly in Unity. [u][url="https://www.youtube.com/shorts/sELS0ooQaQQ"]We adore this glitch gremlin sm.[/url][/u][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]Cabin Tour: Before & After[/h1][p]Time to respawn in Elysia's enchanted home! The familiar space still hums with cosmic charms without losing the earthy cottage comforts from the original setup.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925043/6baae3eceb06f3544c7e6c804d8301af2459857c.png"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][h2]Entryway[/h2][p]A first new impression, still 100% Elysia-coded.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925043/241482d3d890a084e21bead7467dcf9713f2a288.png"][/img][/p][p][img notes.title: V.0.5.4.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Baby AI2U in Early Access got its first patch on Steam! Thank you to all our players for your proactive reports during this early stage. There was a lot to tackle as our Early Access launch marked AI2U's official storyline, and we appreciate all your feedback for ensuring smoother gameplay! 

Here are the fixes and updates you can expect for your gameplay:

[h1]AI Dialogue
[/h1]Adjusted the NPC filter to avoid unfairly flagging words like "butter."

[h1]Bugfixes
[/h1][h2]General[/h2]
  - Fixed the issue where tutorial dialogues occasionally appeared empty.
  - Known issue: The patch notes may not display correctly in the main menu for some players.
[h2]The Atrium
[/h2]  - Fixed the issue where NPCs in Chat Only mode did not acknowledge good endings from the previous round.
  - Fixed the issue where NPC cosmetics would appear inaccurately in the customization preview.
  - Fixed the issue where NPC cosmetics would not apply upon entering a level for the first time.
[h2]Level 1
[/h2]  - Fixed the issue where the catgirl's PC couldn't connect to Wi-Fi even with the correct password.
[h2]Level 2
[/h2]  - Fixed the issue where the witch would get angry repeatedly upon seeing the secret room door open.
  - Fixed the witch's eyebrows to match her cosmetic settings in one of the bad ending cutscenes.
  - Fixed the issue where pressing "V" in the forest maze crashes the game.
  - Fixed the issue where pressing "C" in the forest maze could soft-lock the game.
  - Fixed the issue where identical potion recipes spam the Mission Goal panel.
  - Fixed the issue where potion recipe names were initialized too early in each restarted round.
  - Fixed the issue where ending animations would play in inaccurate map locations.
  - Fixed the issue that caused the ghost to get stuck in the maze.
  - Fixed the issue where the ghost sometimes did not attack players.
  - Known issue: The first time the player gets killed by the ghost outside the cabin, there is a chance that pressing the "Enter" or "C" key won't respond. To temporarily fix this, for the first issue, the player can press "Esc" to pause and unpause the game. For both issues, re-entering the cabin will restore functionality. This issue will be hot fixed soon.
[h2]Level 3
[/h2]  - Fixed an issue where George's ID card couldn't spawn in the level.
  - Fixed the issue where players could not plot a course to the engine room in minimap guide mode.
  - Fixed the issue that caused the NPC to twitch during ending animations.

[h1]Gameplay
[/h1][h2]Level 1
[/h2]  - Adjusted the apartment key spawn locations in the bathrooms and indoor gardens.
[h2]Level 3
[/h2]  - Increased the number of crew member ID cards generated per round.

[h1]Visuals
[/h1][h2]General[/h2]
  - Added visual effects for restoring health.
[h2]Level 2
[/h2] - Improved witch's living room, it's more cozy now (more rooms rework in progress!)
[h2]Level 3
[/h2]  - Added visual effects for speed to some of the ending animations.

[h1]UI
[/h1]  - Adjusted the pointing arrow locations in the tutorial to prevent them from covering item descriptions.
  - Added auto-scroll for long dialogues.
  - Added error messages for failed redemption attempts.
  - Added error messages for failed login attempts.
  - Optimized existing localization options.
  - Renamed "Goth Catgirl" cosmetic to "Jirai Kei Catgirl" for a more accurate representation of its visual style.
    - Known Issue: The catgirl may still call her look "goth" when asked while wearing the renamed outfit.
  
[h1]Audio
[/h1]  - Added sound effects to all Blue Parrot tutorial dialogues.

[h1]HOT FIX - V0.5.4.3.1[/h1]
2025.2.12

- Fixed an issue blocking players from achieving One More Round Achievement if Virtual Caretaker achievement is unlocked at first.
- Adjusted the NPC filter to avoid unfairly flagging words like "hourglass, cucumber."
- Fixed an issue when player is saved by the witch and back to the cabin, enter/c key no longer works.

[h1]Hot Fix - V.0.5.4.3.2[/h1]
2025.2.21

Adjusted the NPC filter to avoid unfairly flagging words like "titan".
Fixed a bug for level 2 potion recipe not displayed correctly in mission window.

[h1]Hot Fix - V.0.5.4.3.3[/h1]
2025.3.26

Add catgirl's birthday cake item!
Catgirl can now realize it is her birthday on March 26th.
Fixed a bug for some mission goals that can't be localized correctly.
Change Dark Blue Crystal to Sapphire.

notes.title: AI2U Region Lock in China: Update & Ongoing Solutions
notes.notes:
We have recently received a notice that Steam has temporarily added a region lock for our game in China after their review.

Our team had already built Chinese language support into AI2U with the intention of allowing players in China to enjoy our game at launch. 

AlterStaff is actively working on potential solutions to this region lock issue and will keep you updated as soon as there is any progress. Rest assured, we will keep you updated on any progress as our team works to unlock access for players in China as soon as possible.

We thank you for your patience and greatly appreciate your support. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused and look forward to resolving this as soon as possible!
